narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video educates viewers on Demodex mites, explaining that symptoms often mistaken for dry skin (redness, itching, dryness) are actually caused by microscopic mites in the pores. It promotes professional dermatological diagnosis over self-treatment with moisturizers.
